method.comparison: Use the frozen dense speech measurement and frequency-balance guard. Compare PCM with native 16 kHz mono AAC-LC at 32 and 64 kbps.
method.condition: The earlier file is the exact uninterrupted dry original. Submitted audio has competing speech 5 dB louder.
method.controls: Count genuine splices separately from ordinary processing, isolated background and an unrelated earlier reader.
method.location: Cover half of the known interval and achieve at least .30 temporal intersection over union.
